title: Decompose chaotic loader: clarify tokenizer handshake and shard resolution
creator: Diego Martinez
description:
Problem: The current model loading pipeline has evolved organically and contains a single, dense Loader class that mixes checkpoint format detection, sharded-weights activation, tokenizer boundary logic, and eager memory accounting. This has caused frequent bugs when onboarding new model formats, edge-case tokenizers, and when attempting low-latency staged activation for large checkpoints.

Goal: Decompose the monolithic loader into three clear responsibilities: format detection + manifest normalization, shard activation and placement protocol, and tokenizer handshake/lexicon binding. The refactor should make the tokenizer contract explicit (versioned handshake), ensure deterministic shard resolution for streaming/partial-load paths, and remove duplication of format parsing across repos. The change must preserve backward compatibility for existing runtime manifests and maintain current load tail latency or improve it.

Scope: - Introduce a Format Normalizer that converts vendor-specific manifests into a small canonical schema. - Add a Shard Resolver service that determines activation order, placement hints, and checksum validation. - Extract a Tokenizer Handshake interface that is invoked once per model boot and exposed as a lightweight RPC for Private deployments. - Migrate two internal formats (legacy-ckpt and legacy-v2) to the canonical manifest.

Out of scope: Rewriting the GPU memory allocator, changing quantization backends, or altering runtime batching behavior. This ticket focuses on pipeline structure and contracts, not algorithmic kernel work.
steps: Audit current loader flows across runtime and private agent (list encountered variations)
Design canonical manifest schema (fields: model_id, format_hint, shards[], tokenizer_meta) and publish Confluence doc
Implement Format Normalizer with adapter registry (pluggable parsers)
Build Shard Resolver to compute activation plan and expose preflight API
Define and implement Tokenizer Handshake interface (versioned JSON RPC + fallback semantics)
Add unit and integration tests (emulate partial loads + tokenization boundary failures)
Run migration on staging with 100 representative models and validate load latency and checksum pass rates
Roll out staged canary to Dedicated pools and monitor regressions before full rollout
acceptance_criteria: Canonical manifest schema documented and approved by runtime team
All existing internal formats normalized by adapter with >=99.9% parity in model outputs on smoke tests
Shard Resolver produces deterministic activation plans (replayable given manifest + seed)
Tokenizer Handshake is invoked exactly once per model boot and exposes lexicon version; fallbacks exercised in tests
End-to-end median model load tail latency does not regress by more than 5% on staging; 95th percentile within current SLO
No production regressions in first canary (72h) across two Dedicated pools before global rollout

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Normalizer may introduce subtle metadata changes breaking downstream placement logic. Mitigation: keep pass-through for unknown fields and log schema diffs in staging for 1 week.

Risk: Tokenizer handshake latency could add to cold-boot time. Mitigation: handshake is async-with-cache for hosted API and only blocking for Private mode; add a small cache warming token in manifest.
Risk: Determinism of activation plan across languages/architectures. Mitigation: include a deterministic seed and canonical sort in resolver; record seed in activation_trace for replay.
Risk: Migration complexity for large customers using custom formats. Mitigation: provide adapter template and runbook; Solutions Eng to schedule migrations and provide a compatibility shim option.
communication_plan: Post design summary to #runtime and #private-agent channels with migration schedule
Early heads-up to Customer Success for impacted enterprise accounts with private deployments
Rollout notes and migration guide to docs.redwood.ai before full release
